title: Clinical Outcomes of Gonioscopy-Assisted Transluminal Trabeculotomy in Eyes After Failed Trabeculectomy

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, MDPI)

indication: refractory open-angle glaucoma after failed trabeculectomy (40 POAG, 22 pseudoexfoliative glaucoma), target IOP not reached on maximal tolerated drops
design: prospective case series of 62 patients (one eye each), two surgeons, at least 12 months of follow-up

groups.indication: open-angle glaucoma after failed trabeculectomy, with cataract
groups.description: phacoemulsification with IOL followed by GATT in the same session (Table 9 'Phaco-GATT')

exclusions.what: Table 2 whole-cohort IOP (62 eyes) and Table 1 cohort preoperative IOP
exclusions.reason: the same eyes are tabulated as subgroups (brief: extract subgroups, not the whole cohort)

exclusions.what: Table 7 IOP by extent of Schlemm's canal deroofing (90-180 vs 190-360 degrees)
exclusions.reason: alternative partition of the same 62 eyes; only one partition can be used without duplicating eyes. The procedure-variant partition of Table 9 (standalone vs combined with phaco) is used because it maps to the group procedure; the deroofing extent was an intraoperative result. One Table 7 cell also uses a decimal comma.

exclusions.what: Table 8 IOP by number of previous glaucoma surgeries (one vs more than one)
exclusions.reason: alternative partition of the same 62 eyes (preoperative condition); not used to avoid duplicating eyes (see Table 7 entry)

exclusions.what: p-value columns of Tables 7-9 and the Table 2 significance footnote

notes: Time ambiguity: the tables label the second postoperative visit '10 D'/'Day 10' and the Methods and Results mention a 10 D visit, while the abstract and the Methods visit list say 7 days; the table label (10 days = 10/30.4375 months = 0.3285) is used. Day 1 = 0.0329 months.
Preoperative IOP on maximal tolerated medical therapy (Discussion); all antiglaucoma medications were withdrawn after surgery and drops were reintroduced when success criteria were not met.

Six patients required additional surgery (two Ahmed valves, two cyclophotocoagulation, one needling revision, one trabeculectomy); the article does not state whether their later IOP values were kept or censored.
Medication: number of antiglaucoma medications per visit is tabulated in Table 6 (whole cohort); not extracted.
Group roles: standalone GATT and Phaco-GATT are standard variants chosen by lens status, no experimental arm; both role control.

series.notes: mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported (all patients had at least 12 months of follow-up)
